requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the energy class must be A1, A2, A3, A4, B or C.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-occupant capacity is not converted into a surface filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The energy class (C or better) and proximity to public transport are outside the reference columns and are not applied here.
User prefers properties near public transport. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).
A university student residence clearly needs nearby education services (universities/schools). 'Convenient' maps to the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: office-type property, surface_area of at least 850 sqm, energy class A1 to C, mobility score of at least 71, and education score of at least 75. The extracted requirements contain no location, so the query orders by id. The 60-person capacity and CDP/PNRR funding are not in the extracted requirements and have no matching allowed column, so they are not filtered.
